question: For the calendar year 2021, what is the overall average quantity sold of the top three best-selling hardware products (by total quantity sold) in each division?
sql:
WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT p.division, f.product_code, SUM(f.sold_quantity) as total_qty
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly f
    JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON f.product_code = p.product_code
    WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2021
    GROUP BY p.division, f.product_code
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT division, product_code, total_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY division ORDER BY total_qty DESC) as rn
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT division, AVG(total_qty) as avg_quantity_sold
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
GROUP BY division
ORDER BY division
